notes:
Cleaner words.

Five things the voice was saying wrong are fixed. “cant”, “wasnt” and “werent” now read as can’t, wasn’t and weren’t — the recogniser drops apostrophes and the voice was saying them as different words. And the scanlation site’s watermark is no longer read aloud in the middle of a scene.

Measured on a device before and after across eight pages: five defects gone, nothing else changed.

If you have not tried it yet — tap a name on the strip while a comic reads to you, and that character speaks from there on.
